text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, isn't that character you drew in your notebook
from "Uma☆Koi"?
Did you draw that, Dober? It's so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh!? N-N-No, no, that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Did someone doodle in my notebook when I lent it to a friend? Haha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh... The worst...
My heart is still pounding like crazy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I've got tomorrow to think about, I have to sleep.
...Have to sleep... Have to sleep........."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, Mejiro Dober ended up
staying up late...
